item.title: Cambridge Gardens / Oxford Road, 3rd October
item.description:
Saturday, 5pm. Rubbish and Unsold items dumped on our streets- the direct aftermath of the London Car Boot Sale. Completely unacceptable that local residents are subjected to this every week. Those profiting from the market need to take responsibility for the mess it leaves behind. In the meantime, those profiting from the Event who anre not local residents are driving back to the countryside where they are residents.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Cambridge Gardens, London

item.title: Flytipped rubbish by bins, 3rd October
item.description:
There’s a heap of flytipped rubbish here - looks like a chest of drawers and furniture. This is a regular occurrence - with rubbish flytipped by these bins from residents on the high street. Residents on Kingsdale Road aren’t allowed to leave bins on the public pavement, so I don’t see why High Street residents can’t leave their bins to the rear of their property, rather than leaving them out on the pavement seven days a week and thereby encouraging regular flytipping.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): High Street, Penge, Greater London
